additionalProjects.name: AI Voice Appointment Booking Agent
additionalProjects.description: Phone-based assistant that handles incoming customer calls, collects required information, answers common questions, creates GoHighLevel appointments, and saves caller details, scheduling information, and conversation summaries directly in CRM meeting notes. Designed the CRM handoff so qualified leads included required call details, appointment context, and next-step notes for follow-up after the call.

additionalProjects.name: AI Customer Support Voice Assistant
additionalProjects.description: Full AI support assistant for product search, order placement, order status checks, and support meeting booking, connecting each flow with CRM records so the support team could continue from the saved customer context.

additionalProjects.name: WorkForce-Connect
additionalProjects.description: Contributed to a Dockerized workforce management system with Strapi CMS, React Admin web backoffice, and Expo/React Native mobile app. Added and improved document management, worker upload flows, admin approval/rejection/hide/unhide controls, compliance coverage reporting, push notification registration, worksheet signing/document sync workflows, and GitHub Actions deployment to AWS ECR.

additionalProjects.name: linkedin-crm
additionalProjects.description: Contributed to a LinkedIn CRM and outreach automation platform with a Next.js frontend, Django REST backend, PostgreSQL database, and Manifest V3 browser extension. Improved onboarding and extension setup, campaign creation UI, prospect list management, inline prospect editing, lead enrichment display, authentication redirects, and extension runtime reliability.

additionalProjects.name: Trakil
additionalProjects.description: Worked from a cloned crypto/blockchain project repository containing a Next.js customer-facing app, Next.js admin dashboard, and Flask token security scanning API. Added and refined token analysis UI/API flows, multilingual crypto security results, provider-based risk displays, and API-backed token scan handling across the web app and scanner service.
